findings.description: The transparent glass cup contains exclusively bright green olives, but as it is poured into the jar, dark purple/black olives unexpectedly appear in the pouring stream and land in the jar.
The second transparent glass cup shows only green olives inside, but when poured, dark purple/black olives emerge from the container alongside green olives.
